svg.title: LSpoof guide: Play a route
svg.desc: Walk, bike or drive, with up to 10 stops. Steps: 1. Set From and To, and add stops if you like 2. Choose a walking or driving path 3. Pick a speed and motion, then start the route
svg.text: Walk, bike or drive, with up to 10 stops.

text.tspan: and add stops if you like

svg.text: Each leg can have its own path and speed.
